source_pin.claim_boundary: prepared external handoff only; no repository-head source acceptance

primary_candidate.role: preferred deterministic SVG-to-PNG derivative renderer once independently executed and accepted
qualification_basis: upstream describes static SVG rendering through library, C library and CLI
upstream states no dependency on system libraries for rendering and documents cross-platform pixel reproducibility
upstream documents checks intended to prevent endless loops and recursion stack overflows
source SVG contract already prohibits script, animation, external references, fonts and embedded raster content

availability.windows_note: Do not claim a prebuilt Windows binary for v0.48.1. Windows execution requires an authorized, independently pinned build/install path or another verified upstream distribution.

promotion_requirements: exact repository-head SVG and manifest must exist and pass source QA
authorized resvg 0.48.1 executable or reproducible build must be independently pinned by hash
render all 12 icons at 16, 20, 24, 32, 48 and 64 px
record exact command line, environment and executable hash
require every icon visible and no nonzero-alpha pixel touching the raster edge
record decoded RGBA hashes for accepted derivatives
rerun a second time and require byte-identical PNG output from the same pinned executable and inputs
compare decoded pixels against an independent renderer without requiring cross-renderer byte identity
do not promote PNGs to imported/runtime_verified until Astral image import, alpha, tint, filtering, DPI and atlas behavior are natively proven

security_notes: versions below 2.9.0 are affected by the upstream recursive-use amplification denial-of-service advisory
2.9.1 is itself a security update for specially crafted SVGs with very long paths causing exponential rendering time
the installed 2.8.2 copy is therefore not eligible as the canonical production rasterizer

comparison_tools.note: Keep the installed 1.4 copy as an independent comparison renderer only; do not call it the current stable release or canonical derivative path.

scope_boundary: This contract selects a test candidate and acceptance procedure only. It installs nothing, spends nothing, changes no runtime code, and does not establish Astral image support or UE/Unity parity.
